req.title: List returns empty array when db empty
req.statement: The system shall return an empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist.
triggers: list returns empty array when db empty

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-033 requires GET /tasks/ to return an empty JSON array when no tasks exist. To test this deterministically, we must override the database dependency to use an in-memory SQLite DB with no rows. Three tests are designed: (1) positive — empty DB yields [], status 200, Content-Type JSON; (2) negative — invalid query param yields 422 (client error path); (3) boundary — DB with exactly zero rows vs one row, asserting the transition from [] to a single-element array, catching off-by-one and comparison mutations.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array
actions: Override get_db dependency with in-memory SQLite session containing no rows
trace: R-TASK-033: system shall return empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_get_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

    def override_get_db():
        db = TestSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/tasks/")
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == []
    assert "application/json" in response.headers["content-type"]

test_get_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_get_tasks_zero_vs_one_row_boundary():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    shared_db = TestSession()

    def override_get_db():
        try:
            yield shared_db
        finally:
            pass

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)

    r0 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    assert r0.json() == []

    task = models.Task(title="Read chapter 5", description=None, completed=True)
    shared_db.add(task)
    shared_db.commit()

    r1 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    body = r1.json()
    assert len(body) == 1
    assert body[0]["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body[0]["completed"] is True

    shared_db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_get_tasks_zero_vs_one_row_boundary()
